purpose: Coordinate CSD-005 through CSD-009 as one dependency-aware scene intelligence pipeline and determine when a multi-character scene is ready for CSD-002 storyboard production.
core_principle: The orchestrator selects and orders intelligence work from scene requirements; downstream modules never bypass their required upstream state.

adaptive_policy.principle: Run every mandatory gate, but adapt optional work according to scene complexity and detected state changes.

adaptive_actions.single_character_low_complexity: CSD-005 may use simplified relationship resolution while CSD-006 through CSD-009 remain validation-capable.
adaptive_actions.high_relationship_density: prioritize CSD-005 relationship and power analysis before state propagation.
adaptive_actions.high_emotional_transition: force full CSD-006 resolution before perception.
adaptive_actions.high_knowledge_conflict: force full CSD-007 reconciliation and contradiction tracking.
adaptive_actions.multiple_perspectives: require full CSD-008 and CSD-009 differentiation validation.
adaptive_actions.high_continuity_risk: require explicit continuity checks before CSD-009 promotion.

execution_policy: Validate 1–5 registered active characters before orchestration.
Resolve CSD-005 before downstream state modules.
CSD-006 and CSD-007 may execute independently after CSD-005 when their inputs are available.
CSD-008 cannot execute until emotional and knowledge states are resolved.
CSD-009 cannot execute until perception plus upstream emotional/knowledge states are available.
Any BLOCKER short-circuits downstream production promotion.
Rework returns to the earliest failed causal layer rather than regenerating the entire scene blindly.
Advisories may proceed but remain attached to the production handoff.
CSD-002 receives one consolidated orchestration package, not disconnected module outputs.
Identity locks remain immutable throughout orchestration.

rework_example.failure: CSD-009 detects unknown-information leak in RAVAN_001 perspective
rework_example.action: recalculate perception using CSD-007 information boundary
rework_example.then: rerun CSD-009 only; do not discard valid CSD-005/CSD-006/CSD-007 state
